lines.text: We gathered feedback from last month's survey. Our satisfaction score improved.

lines.text: Great, what were the main customer insights?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Slow delivery is still a pain point. But we got a great testimonial we can use in ads.

lines.text: Perfect, let's analyze the data further and write a case study.
